site_facts.method: read from the business own live website on 2026-08-08

name.note: Their own site trades as Touchstone Mobile Detailing. The lead row name Touchstone Detailing is short by one word. Use the site name.

tagline.value: Your Vehicle Deserves The Best. We'll Handle the Rest.

hours.note: Their own site contradicts itself. The contact page main block and their structured data both say 7 AM to 5 PM; the footer says 6 AM to 6 PM. The 7 to 5 pair agrees across two independent places, so it is used here. Flag to the prospect rather than silently picking one on their live site.

warranty.note: Appears as a section heading on the home page and again as SATISFACTION GUARANTEED on their own badge graphic. There is no warranty term or duration stated anywhere.

years_in_business.note: The about page words it as founded over 10 years ago with mobile detailing starting in summer 2008.

makes.note: No vehicle makes and no product brands are named. The site says premium products only.

service_groups.note: Their own six service pages plus the steps each page describes. Wording is ours, not theirs. Odor removal and paint correction appear in their structured data description but have no service page, so they were left out.
